core_obligations: Choose generators of M corresponding to a surjection from a free module and use Nakayama to select a minor of the relation matrix that generates the Fitting ideal (proof lines 1587-1597).
Record that all other minors are multiples of f and construct a right inverse for the relation matrix, up to the factor f (proof lines 1597-1607).
Define the n - k combinations y_i of the chosen generators that are killed by f and observe that the module modulo them is generated by the remaining k generators (proof lines 1607-1612).
Conclude that the quotient of M by its f-torsion is generated by k elements (proof lines 1612-1613).
proof_roadmap: Present M and pick the minor generating the Fitting ideal (proof lines 1587-1597).
Produce the annihilated combinations and conclude (proof lines 1607-1613).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that for a finite module over a local ring whose k-th Fitting ideal is generated by one element f, the quotient by the f-torsion is generated by k elements, and the proof is a 27-line matrix argument. It chooses a surjection from a free module, uses Nakayama to replace a generating set of the Fitting ideal by a single minor of the relation matrix, constructs a right inverse for the relation matrix up to the factor f, and then exhibits n - k explicit combinations of the chosen generators that are killed by f; since the remaining n - k generators already generate the module modulo those combinations, the quotient by the f-torsion is generated by k elements. The Nakayama step and the construction of the annihilated combinations are the content, and both are displayed.
